readings: For each invoice, show the invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and how many line items it has. Give the 10 invoices with the most line items, from most to fewest.
queries:
SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / derived_product_cost) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
GROUP BY invoice_number
ORDER BY line_item_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
